speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inappropriate behavior. I also have Disinterest in family interactions, Craving for specific foods, Significant weight gain, Apathy, Blunted affect.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Kluver-Bucy Syndrome.

The combination of hyperphagia with specific food cravings, hypersexuality/inappropriate behavior, placidity (apathy, disinterest), and unkempt appearance in a 55-year-old male, with normal thyroid and pituitary labs, is highly specific to bilateral damage to the anterior temporal lobes, often caused by herpes simplex encephalitis or prior trauma.
